In Camp Manager Simulator, you start with a modest patch of land and gradually grow your business, from simple tents to far larger facilities.Camp Manager Simulator will be available on PC (Steam) in Q4 2026. It is also coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S. A free demo will be available on PC on September 10, 2026.
